title: Site Settings
description: GENERATED by `wp lp acf:build` — edits here are overwritten.

fields.name: theme_signal
fields.label: Signal
fields.instructions: Yellow keeps Marquee/CTA/Private Coaching yellow. Light ground makes Pricing white and Clients/Locations the accent band.

fields.name: contact_email
fields.label: Contact email
fields.instructions: Enquiry form recipient. Falls back to the WordPress admin email when empty.

fields.name: whatsapp_url
fields.label: WhatsApp group URL
fields.instructions: School-wide chat.whatsapp.com invite. Used on paid booking confirmations when the class and site have no URL of their own. Never output on an unconfirmed visit.

fields.name: seo_title
fields.label: Default title
fields.instructions: Homepage title, and the fallback when a page has no SEO title. Aim for 30–60 characters.

fields.name: seo_description
fields.label: Default description
fields.instructions: Fallback meta / Open Graph description when a page has none of its own. Aim for ~150–160 characters.

fields.name: seo_image
fields.label: Default share image
fields.instructions: og:image when a page has no SEO image and no featured image. Landscape, at least 1200×630.

fields.name: seo_org_types
fields.label: Organisation schema types
fields.instructions: JSON-LD @type for the organisation node. SportsClub + LocalBusiness is the default.

fields.name: seo_org_name
fields.label: Organisation name
fields.instructions: Defaults to the WordPress site title when empty.

fields.name: seo_org_email
fields.label: Organisation email
fields.instructions: Shown on the organisation node. Falls back to Contact email, then hello@londonparkour.com.

fields.name: seo_org_phone
fields.label: Organisation phone
fields.instructions: E.164 if possible, e.g. +44 20 1234 5678. Leave empty to omit.

fields.name: seo_same_as
fields.label: sameAs profiles
fields.instructions: Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, GBP, etc. Leave empty to keep the three built-in profiles.
